stories.headline: House bill seeks stronger markets for underused wood
stories.body: Representatives Kim Schrier and GT Thompson introduced the Forest Bioeconomy Act, H.R. 11072, on November 18 to connect Forest Service research more closely with manufacturers and develop uses for wood that has little commercial value. The…

stories.headline: Canada opens a purchasing route for wood-based carbon removal
stories.body: Canada’s Treasury Board announced 19 competitively established carbon-removal standing offers on November 19. Designated federal departments, agencies and Crown corporations can use them through March 31, 2029, with an extension option.

featuredResource.title: BARK — Bick’s App for Resource Know-How
featuredResource.description: BARK is a browser-based field-calculator app for tree and stand measurements. Its tools cover timber volume, biomass, basal area, sampling dimensions and related estimates, with formulas and references shown.
